messages:
maria_billing: Heads-up: customer NovaQ disputed invoice INV-2026-119 — they were charged $1,600 in burst on 2026-04-02 when their dedicated commit should have covered it. Claim: AZ failover moved traffic to shared pool and we billed incorrectly. Can ops confirm meter attribution before we promise anything to the customer?

sam_ops: Looking now. I see an AZ failover at 02:47 UTC and a node fence that bounced their dedicated node and spilled 2.5h of inference to on-demand. Routing did not attach the commit_tag because their node came back with suffix "-legacy" from a stale image. :grimacing:

maria_billing: Can you paste the raw meter rows / invoice line ids so I can match to INV-2026-119 lines 5-8? We need exact amounts to propose credit.

sam_ops: Meter extract: 
```
customer,commit_id,az,usage_tokens,charge_cents,tag
novaq,commit-NQ-2,eu-west-1a,0,0,reserved
novaq,commit-NQ-2,eu-west-1b,900000,80000,shared
novaq,commit-NQ-2-legacy,eu-west-1c,450000,80000,burst
```
The second/third rows correspond to the $1,600 overage (80,000 + 80,000 cents). The root cause is the commit tag mismatch (commit-NQ-2 vs commit-NQ-2-legacy).

tyler_sales: Customer is upset; AM asked for an SLA credit per our failover policy. Policy: if failover caused billing to shared pool and it's our routing bug, we offer 75% credit of the overage unless it's a repeated incident. This would be $1,200. CS wants that number to give customer immediately.

emma_csm: Confirming NovaQ's AM requested an immediate remedial credit while engineering fixes the tagging mapping. They also want assurance we will re-run billing and not double-credit.

maria_billing: Finance preliminary ok with provisional credit up to $1,200 (GL 6110 - Customer Credits). Need ops to queue a reprocess and to confirm ticket for image/stale-tag fix. Also need a short note for customer response: "We identified a tagging mismatch during an AZ failover; we've issued a provisional credit while we reprocess usage and will confirm final amounts."

sam_ops: Creating infra ticket: INFRA-8932 "legacy-image tag suffix causing commit mismatch". Will patch mapping table and reprocess window. Command: `infractl billing reprocess --customer novaq --from 2026-04-02T02:30Z --to 2026-04-02T05:00Z --fix-tags commit-suffix-strip`

billing-bot: Action accepted: "billing reprocess queued (job_id: br-20260402-912). ETA 6m." :robot_face:

maria_billing: I'll author a provisional credit memo ($1,200) and mark it pending-reprocess; tag with INV-2026-119 and br-20260402-912. Please post here when re-agg completes.

billing-bot: Reprocess complete: "br-20260402-912: 2 meter rows reclassified from shared/burst to reserved, re-aggregation scheduled (agg_id: agg-20260402-190)"

sam_ops: Re-agg finished and invoice lines updated. Reconciled amounts show overage absorbed by reclassification; final outstanding credit = $0.

tyler_sales: Great, let's cancel provisional credit and notify customer that no charge will remain. I'll coordinate AM reply.

emma_csm: I'll send a conciliatory note and close the loop. Thanks all.
